carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

A handrail in a rehabilitation hospital.

That is one of the sites the University of Texas at Austin names for its new robotics center. The National Science Foundation award record is dated August 25th, 2026. Its own instrument field reads cooperative agreement. It creates a Science and Technology Center for human and robot co-adaptation.

The agency's release names homes and hospitals, workplaces and public spaces. The university names more than that. Houses and dorms. Cafes and a public museum. Elder-care and assisted-living residences. The most specific list on the record is the awardee's own.

The deck sets the award record beside that site list and the consent and opt-out procedures the university says its ethics board will develop.

Work runs September 1st, 2026 to August 31st, 2031. Which residents get asked before it starts?

#UTAustin #GoodSystems #NSF
